skills.summary: Contrast open-loop and closed-loop control and name the plant, sensor, actuator, controller, reference and disturbance.

skills.name: Block-diagram algebra
skills.summary: Reduce series, parallel and feedback interconnections to a single transfer function.

skills.name: Simple feedback: on-off, P, PI, PID
skills.summary: Compare on-off, proportional, integral and derivative action qualitatively and predict steady-state error.

skills.name: Modeling with differential equations
skills.summary: Write ODE models of mechanical, electrical and fluid elements from physical laws.

skills.name: State-space models
skills.summary: Put an n-th order ODE or coupled ODEs into x'=Ax+Bu, y=Cx+Du form.

skills.name: Cruise control as a feedback example
skills.summary: Model a vehicle speed loop with drag and grade disturbance and see what P and PI control achieve.

skills.name: Laplace transform and its properties
skills.summary: Transform signals and ODEs, use derivative/integral rules and the final value theorem.

skills.name: Modeling methodology: scaling, units, identification
skills.summary: Choose states, nondimensionalize, and pick model fidelity for a control purpose.

skills.name: First-order systems
skills.summary: Find time constant, DC gain, step and free response of a first-order system and its control.

skills.name: Second-order systems: damping and natural frequency
skills.summary: Relate zeta and omega_n to pole locations and to under/over/critically damped responses.

skills.name: Step-response specifications
skills.summary: Compute rise time, overshoot, settling time and steady-state error, and map them to the s-plane.

skills.name: PID control law and its effects
skills.summary: Predict how proportional, integral and derivative gains change the closed-loop poles and errors.

skills.name: Integrator windup and anti-windup
skills.summary: Explain actuator saturation windup and design back-calculation or clamping anti-windup.

skills.name: PID tuning (Ziegler-Nichols and model-based)
skills.summary: Tune a PID from step or ultimate-gain experiments and from a first-order-plus-delay model.

skills.name: PID implementation: derivative filtering, setpoint weighting, discretization
skills.summary: Filter the derivative, weight setpoints and discretize a PID for a computer.

skills.name: Matrix exponential and the general solution
skills.summary: Solve x'=Ax+Bu with e^{At} and the convolution integral.

skills.name: Eigenvalues, modes and diagonalization
skills.summary: Decompose a response into modes using eigenvectors and Jordan form.

skills.name: From state space to transfer function
skills.summary: Compute G(s)=C(sI-A)^{-1}B+D and relate poles to eigenvalues.

skills.name: Realizations: controllable and observable canonical forms
skills.summary: Build a state-space realization from a transfer function; note non-uniqueness.

skills.name: Stability of LTI systems
skills.summary: Decide asymptotic and BIBO stability from eigenvalues or poles; Routh-Hurwitz test.

skills.name: Frequency response of a general LTI system
skills.summary: Get steady-state sinusoidal response from G(j omega) for state-space and TF models.

skills.name: Linear algebra for state space
skills.summary: Rank, null space, eigenvalues and similarity transforms as used in control.

skills.name: Discrete-time systems and sampling
skills.summary: Model sampled systems as difference equations and check stability inside the unit circle.

skills.name: Loop transfer function and the Gang of Four
skills.summary: Form L=PC and the closed-loop maps S, T, PS, CS from reference, disturbance and noise.

skills.name: Root locus
skills.summary: Sketch how closed-loop poles move with gain using asymptotes, breakaway and angle rules.

skills.name: Nyquist plot and stability criterion
skills.summary: Count encirclements of -1 to infer closed-loop unstable poles.

skills.name: Time delay in feedback loops
skills.summary: Represent delay as e^{-sT}, see its phase lag, and use Padé approximations.

skills.name: Gain, phase and stability margins
skills.summary: Read gain, phase and stability margins from Bode and Nyquist plots.

skills.name: Bode's relations and minimum-phase systems
skills.summary: Relate gain slope to phase and recognize nonminimum-phase zeros and delays.

skills.name: Generalized gain, describing functions
skills.summary: Extend gain/phase to nonlinear elements via describing functions and the small-gain idea.

skills.name: Sensitivity functions and disturbance rejection
skills.summary: Use S and T to quantify disturbance attenuation, noise and tracking.

skills.name: Modeling uncertainty
skills.summary: Describe parametric and unmodeled-dynamics uncertainty with additive/multiplicative bounds.

skills.name: Robust stability
skills.summary: Apply the small-gain test |T Δ|<1 and stability margins to uncertain plants.

skills.name: Robust performance
skills.summary: Keep specs under uncertainty using weighted S and T bounds.

skills.name: Feedforward design and 2-DOF control
skills.summary: Add reference and disturbance feedforward to a feedback loop.

skills.name: Frequency-domain performance specifications
skills.summary: Translate bandwidth, peak sensitivity and crossover into design targets.

skills.name: Loop shaping with lead and lag compensators
skills.summary: Shape L(j omega) with lead/lag/PI to meet margins and bandwidth.

skills.name: Fundamental limitations: RHP zeros, delays, Bode integral
skills.summary: Bound achievable bandwidth from RHP poles/zeros and the waterbed effect.

skills.name: Reachability (controllability)
skills.summary: Test reachability with the rank of [B AB ... ] and reach canonical form.

skills.name: State feedback and pole placement
skills.summary: Choose K so that A-BK has desired eigenvalues; Ackermann's formula.

skills.name: Integral action in state feedback
skills.summary: Augment the state with an error integrator to remove steady-state error.

skills.name: Linear quadratic regulator
skills.summary: Pick weights Q, R and interpret the LQR gain trade-off.

skills.name: Observability
skills.summary: Test observability with the rank of [C; CA; ...] and observable canonical form.

skills.name: State estimation with observers
skills.summary: Design an observer gain L so that A-LC is fast and stable.

skills.name: Output feedback and the separation principle
skills.summary: Combine state feedback with an observer and see that the eigenvalues separate.

skills.name: Kalman filtering
skills.summary: Estimate states optimally under process and sensor noise.

skills.name: General controller structure
skills.summary: Combine feedforward, state feedback and estimation into a 2-DOF structure.

skills.name: Equilibrium points and phase portraits
skills.summary: Find equilibria and sketch phase portraits of 2-D nonlinear systems.

skills.name: Linearization about an equilibrium
skills.summary: Compute Jacobians and use local linear models for analysis and control.

skills.name: Lyapunov stability
skills.summary: Prove stability with a Lyapunov function and the Lyapunov equation.

skills.name: Limit cycles, bifurcations and nonlocal behavior
skills.summary: Recognize limit cycles, regions of attraction and parameter bifurcations.

skills.name: Feedback linearization
skills.summary: Cancel nonlinearities with input transformations to get linear dynamics.

skills.name: Gain scheduling
skills.summary: Interpolate linear controllers designed at several operating points.

skills.name: System identification
skills.summary: Fit a model from step/frequency data and least squares.

skills.name: Model predictive control (intro)
skills.summary: Solve a receding-horizon optimization with constraints at each step.

skills.name: Adaptive control (intro)
skills.summary: Update controller parameters online from estimates.

skills.name: Applications tour: op-amps, AFM, drug dosing, populations
skills.summary: Apply modeling and feedback ideas to the textbook's application families.
